build_resnet_model: build a ResNet model with specified number of classes and optional batch norm configuration
create_block_group: create a block group that stacks multiple bottleneck blocks with given channel dimensions
create_bottleneck_block_v1: create a ResNet v1 bottleneck block with configurable channels stride and projection
create_bottleneck_block_v2: create a ResNet v2 bottleneck block with pre-activation and configurable channels
test_resnet_forward_pass: test the ResNet forward pass with input tensor and verify output shape matches num_classes
